notes: Everything left over from the unwired-controls audit. Three query replies arrive with no command name on the wire, and each had a feature waiting on it: server administration, the permission finder's effective value, and a client's database detail. The server log read the wrong key, so it was always empty. Push-to-talk finally has a button on the Mac, applying an audio profile applies all of it, and the iPhone gains avatar upload, complaints, kick/ban, contacts, whisper lists and channel passwords.
